run_images2coco_cli: run the images2coco CLI to convert a directory of images into COCO-format JSON annotations
create_collect_image_infos: create a function that scans a directory recursively and collects image metadata including filename, width, and height
build_coco_json: build a COCO-format JSON object from a list of image info dictionaries and a list of class names
test_parse_args: test the argparse argument parser that accepts img_path, classes, out, and optional exclude_extensions
summarize_main: summarize the main entry point that orchestrates collecting images, converting to COCO format, and dumping the JSON output
